meta.interpretation: The user wants the phase breakdown of melanoma clinical trials — how many trials fall into Early Phase 1, Phase 1, 2, 3, 4 (and phase-not-applicable studies).
assumptions: Restricted to interventional studies, since observational trials carry no phase.
Limited to trials starting from 2015 onward to reflect the current landscape; can be widened to all years on request.
'melanoma' passed as a condition term, letting the registry expand synonyms and MeSH variants (includes uveal/mucosal melanoma where indexed).
Phase-not-applicable trials are kept as their own bar, since they are a real part of the distribution.
Trials registered across two phases (e.g. Phase 1/2) are counted in each phase, so bars may sum to more than the trial total.
meta.counting_semantics: A trial may report several values for trial phase, so it is counted once per value. Bucket values therefore sum to more than the number of trials.
